items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: Joe Smith, Bubber Miley, myself, all, bunch of us, you know, up to the nightclub... we'd all go uptown here and hang out with all the musicians and fellows... Coleman Hawkins, all of us hang out together, Joe Smith

ctx.x: Yeah, a good piano player, Harvey Brooks. Joe Smith on trumpet.
